summary: Preserve the anonymous Q&A through Clerk signup, import to a session, and stamp conversion
description: Depends on the CTA + guest_queries. Stash the guest Q&A keyed to the signed guest token; after Clerk signup completes, import: create a real sessions row + queries row for the new user so they land mid-research at /chat/<sessionId>, snapshot free-tier voice per BRD-chat-voice §5, and UPDATE the originating guest_queries row SET converted_user_id = new user (so admin can measure conversion and the row isn't double-counted as spend against a user). Guard against double-import on refresh. Include a test.
